channel.title: Psychology Research Digest
channel.itunes:author: Felix
channel.description: Twice-weekly deep-dives into music psychology, affective science, and behavioural research.
channel.itunes:summary: Curated literature breakdowns covering music cognition, rhythm, emotional regulation, and clinical psychology.

item.title: Morning Research Briefing: Shared music listening, emotional arousal and cognitive...
item.description:
Today's Morning Science Briefing:

  • Shared music listening, emotional arousal and cognitive empathy enhance social presence in online interactions — Pyry Heikkinen, Vesa Putkinen, Mari H. Tervaniemi (Cognitive Processing, 2026)
  • Acting together beyond synchrony: Event-dependent alignment of breathing in an expert musical ensemble — Kohei Miyata, Sayumi Kamata, Daichi Shimizu, Akira Takaoka, Martin R. L. Clayton, Kazutoshi Kudo (Acta Psychologica, 2026)
  • A multidisciplinary systematic review for the role of digital human models in assessing and treating altered body experience in eating disorders — Giulia Brizzi, Margherita Boltri, Simone Borsci, Russell Weili Chan, Funda Yildirim, Steven Truijen, Giuseppe Riva, Sofia Scataglini (Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 2026)
